# Hono Gotchas

> Known Hono (Node.js web framework) patterns that cause silent failures or hard-to-debug errors.

## Entries

- [Splitting a monolith Hono route file: registration order is semantic](route-registration-order-on-split.md): Overlapping patterns match in registration order and app.use only covers routes registered after it, so splitting a big route file into sub-routers can silently change which handler wins or drop middleware. Preserve order, hoist middleware to the parent, and diff app.routes before/after. HIGH.
- [Filtering app.routes on method ALL hides app.all routes from auth tests](app-routes-all-method-hides-app-all.md): app.use(fn), app.use(path, fn) and app.all(path, h) are all method ALL in app.routes; only path `/*` marks global middleware, so a method filter drops app.all routes from 'every route needs auth' tests. Assert the auth middleware's index too. HIGH.
- [hc<App> types nothing when routes are registered imperatively instead of chained](hc-app-types-nothing-when-routes-are-registered-imperatively-instead-of-chained.md): Hono's RPC client `hc<App>` only knows the routes whose types were accumulated by chaining (`app.get(...).post(...)` or `app.route(...)` with the returned value), so routes registered by side effect… HIGH.

## See also

- [`Referrer-Policy: no-referrer` also nulls `Origin` on form POSTs](../web-security/referrer-policy-nulls-origin-on-form-post.md) (kb/web-security): bites any Hono app that pairs a `no-referrer` HTML response with an `Origin`-matching CSRF middleware -- every form POST arrives as `Origin: null` and is refused, while GET routes keep working. Not counted as a Hono entry; the behaviour is the browser's, not the router's. HIGH.
